mission: Make capturing a thought effortless and calm.
value_proposition: Two-tap capture, no clutter, pay once.
target_user: People who think on the go

principles.name: Two-tap capture
principles.statement: Writing a note starts within two taps from launch.
principles.check: UI test: launch → add → title field focused in ≤2 taps

principles.name: Calm by default
principles.check: No notification permission request in the app

principles.name: Fair pricing
principles.statement: Pay once; free tier stays useful.
principles.check: Only non-consumable products exist; free tier has a limit, not a trial

tone_of_voice.ja: 落ち着いた、やさしい「です・ます」調で簡潔に。

decision_rules: If it adds a step to capture, it's out.
